kurals.tr: Sellitaththuk Kaappaan Sinangaappaan Allitaththuk / Kaakkinen Kaavaakkaal En?
kurals.m: He restrains his anger who restrains it when it can injure; when it cannot injure, what does it matter whether he restrain it, or not ?

kurals.tr: Sellaa Itaththuch Chinandheedhu Sellitaththum / Iladhanin Theeya Pira
kurals.m: Anger is bad, even when it cannot injure; when it can injure; there is no greater evil

kurals.tr: Maraththal Vekuliyai Yaarmaattum Theeya / Piraththal Adhanaan Varum
kurals.m: Forget anger towards every one, as fountains of evil spring from it

kurals.tr: Nakaiyum Uvakaiyum Kollum Sinaththin / Pakaiyum Ulavo Pira
kurals.m: What other foe to man works such annoy?

kurals.tr: Thannaiththaan Kaakkin Sinangaakka Kaavaakkaal / Thannaiye Kollunj Chinam
kurals.m: If a man would guard himself, let him guard against anger; if he do not guard it, anger will kill him

kurals.tr: Sinamennum Serndhaaraik Kolli Inamennum / Emap Punaiyaich Chutum
kurals.m: The fire of anger will burn up even the pleasant raft of friendship

kurals.tr: Sinaththaip Porulendru Kontavan Ketu / Nilaththaraindhaan Kaipizhaiyaa Thatru
kurals.m: Destruction will come upon him who ragards anger as a good thing, as surely as the hand of him who strikes the ground will not fail

kurals.tr: Inareri Thoivanna Innaa Seyinum / Punarin Vekulaamai Nandru
kurals.m: Though one commit things against you as painful (to bear) as if a bundle of fire had been thrust upon you, it will be well, to refrain, if possible, from anger

kurals.tr: Ulliya Thellaam Utaneydhum Ullaththaal / Ullaan Vekuli Enin
kurals.m: If a man never indulges anger in his heart, he will at once obtain whatever he has thought of

kurals.tr: Irandhaar Irandhaar Anaiyar Sinaththaith / Thurandhaar Thurandhaar Thunai
kurals.m: Those, who give way to excessive anger, are no better than dead men; but those, who are freed from it, are equal to those who are freed (from death)
